definition: A reflected glow that spreads from a bright source.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
quote: On the other side of the house an immense fire had burned itself into clear embers and shed a steady, red reverberation, contrasted strongly with the mellow paleness of the moon.
example_sentence: The reverberation of the bells hung in the cold air.
